code: local RS=game:GetService("RunService") pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep("FantasyShot") end) RS:BindToRenderStep("FantasyShot",Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+1,function() local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera local cf=workspace:GetAttribute("ShotCF") if cf then cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable cam.CFrame=cf cam.FieldOfView=workspace:GetAttribute("ShotFov") or 60 end end) for _,g in ipairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA("ScreenGui") then g.Enabled=false end end local c=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character if c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then c.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored=true end return "bound"
